Investigations launched into alleged filming by smart glasses wearers

Paris prosecutors have opened several investigations following complaints that women were filmed on the street without their consent by individuals wearing smart glasses. Campaigners across Europe are calling for action against the devices, which they refer to as "pervert" smart glasses. Separately, police are investigating a video showing a man in smart glasses allegedly trailing female students.
